faqs.a:
(a)
A person shall be adjudged a habitual offender if the person:
(1)
Accumulates three convictions for separate and distinct offenses described in
section 14-51
or
14-52
committed during a consecutive five-year period; or
(2)
Accumulates three convictions for separate and distinct offenses of any section described
               in this chapter committed during a one-year period.
(b)
Conviction for more than one offense arising from the same date, set of facts, and
               circumstances, shall not constitute separate and distinct offenses for purposes of
               this section.
(c)
The controlling date is the date of each offense, not the date of conviction.
(
Ord. No. 4028, § 5, 10-16-2006
)
